blocks.text: The word "**свой**" is declined like "**мой**". The preposition "**с**" becomes "**со**" before the word "**свой**": **со своего стола**, **со своим братом**.
The possessive "**свой**" indicates that the object belongs to the performer of the action: *Я взял свои книги. Он взял свои книги. Вы взяли свои книги.*

points: When the performer of the action is in the 3rd person: 1) the possessives "**его**, **её**, **их**" are used if the object does not belong to the performer of the action; 2) if the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "**свой**" must be used: *Он говорил с его женой* (someone else's, not his own). *Он говорил со своей женой* (his own wife).

When the performer of the action is the 1st or 2nd person either "**мой**, **твой**, **наш**, **ваш**" or "**свой**" may be used without any change of meaning: *Я взял мою книгу.* or *Я взял свою книгу.*
As a rule "**свой**" modifies the object only.

blocks.text: From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 49.
